text:
maria: heads up — we're scheduling a lightweight base-image rebuild for runtime sandboxes this Thurs. goal: strip unused pkgs, add seccomp profile, enable layered SBOMs, and sign images with KMS-backed cosign. need RBAC/KMS audit + incident playbook update :eyes:

alex: thanks — can you list exact RBAC deltas you expect? i.e. which service accounts need KMS encrypt/sign roles?

maria: initial ask: build-sa needs kms.cryptoSign for signer keyring and iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator for the deployer. also runtime nodes need iam.serviceAccountUser on the runtime-sa to pull signed images from GCR.

samir: +1 on the perms. we should avoid broad roles; prefer specific bindings to the key ring resource. i'll draft a minimal IAM patch.

elaine: also worth noting audit log pathing: whatever writes to Cloud Audit Logs needs to be forwarded to SIEM. can we add a filter for cosign signing events? security-bot can emit a webhook.

security-bot: checklist: 1) kms key policy reviewed 2) cosign workflow dry-run 3) RBAC change PR 4) audit forwarding test 5) emergency rollback playbook updated.

alex: i'm worried about the signer key in KMS — we need an emergency rotation/playground plan for a key compromise. samir, can you include key rotation and versioning notes in the PR?

samir: yep. plan: pre-create alternate key version, test signing with --key VERSION, and bake rotation into deployer runbook. will include steps to revoke key and fallback to ephemeral signing (local ephemeral keypair) during KMS outage.

maria: runtime canary plan: tag images with :rebase-canary-{{ts}} and deploy 3 pods in sandbox cluster-a, 2 pods in canary cluster-b. monitor FIPS, latency, crashloop counts for 30m.

frank: do we have a canary gate in Console/rollouts to auto-stop if crashloop >1? if not i'll add a temporary alert rule.

alex: RBAC PR: add 3 bindings — kms.cryptoSign on keyRing/keystore/sandbox-signer to build-sa, iam.serviceAccountUser to runtime nodes, and logging.writer to the audit-forwarder-sa. limit to resource-level. share diff.

maria: sample cosign command we plan to use in the pipeline:
```
export COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1
cosign sign --key kms://projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/sandbox-signer 
  gcr.io/redwood/sandbox-base:rebase-canary-1790012345
```

elaine: can the audit-forwarder include the cosign key id in the log payload? that'll help triage which key version signed the image.

samir: yes, cosign attaches a signature metadata header; we'll map that to structured fields in the forwarder. adding a filter to SIEM for cosign.signature and kms.cryptoKeyVersion.

security-bot: reminder — verify container scan against policies after rebuild. critical CVEs must block canary promotion.

maria: vuln triage: we removed curl and wget from the base; replaced with busybox and an internal fetcher binary. build of the minimal base reduced the attack surface. still need to validate dynamic loader CVEs.

frank: noted. i'll run an SBOM diff and post results to the thread before the canary window.

ops-bot: scheduled: canary deployment window Thu 03:00 UTC -> Thu 05:00 UTC for sandbox clusters. notifier: #eng-oncall.

alex: for incident response, please update the playbook with: 1) how to detect cosign signature anomalies 2) steps to revoke KMS key 3) rollback image tag mapping 4) who owns oncall rotations. want this PR merged before we start.

maria: i'll open three PRs: RBAC IAM terraform patch, pipeline cosign change + pipeline test, and playbook + runbook updates. will tag reviewers @alex @samir @elaine.

samir: prepping the IAM PR now, will include terraform plan output and a short justification for each binding.

elaine: i'll wire up the audit-forwarder test and post a sample log with cosign metadata.

frank: SBOM diff uploaded: small reduction in surface area, one new libssl transient version flagged — marking for triage (low/upgrade planned).

maria: perfect. if we get RBAC sign-off by EOD tomorrow we can keep Thu window. otherwise bump 48h. thanks all :rocket:

alex: acked. i'll review IAM PR first thing.

security-bot: post-action: attach runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/base-image-rebuild (dry-run)

maria: thread summary for the release notes: "Sandbox base-image rebuild: minimal runtime footprint, seccomp profile added, cosign signing via KMS, RBAC tightened (build-sa kms.cryptoSign only), audit forwarding validated, canary window Thu 03:00UTC."

alex: leaving comments on the PRs — please respond inline.

samir: uploaded key rotation playbook snippet to PR.

maria: thanks everyone. tagging this thread as resolved once PRs merged.
